summary.whatChanges: When `vitest list` uses static parsing, collection/parse failures in test files now set the process exit code to 1 instead of exiting successfully. E2E tests and snapshots cover basic, `--json`, and `--json=<file>` output modes for this case.
behaviorChanges: `vitest list` with static parsing exits with code 1 when a file fails to parse or contains no test suite
Errors such as "No test suite found in file ..." are reported on stderr with an empty stdout and a failing exit status
CI pipelines running `vitest list` in static-parse mode will now fail on parse errors rather than pass
risks: Scripts or CI that tolerated a zero exit code from `vitest list` may now break when any file fails static parsing
process.exitCode is set globally, so a subsequent successful operation in the same process would still exit non-zero unless reset
